text:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector rollout (yesterday), we've seen a consistent p95 tail increase on host-side for short requests (~8-12% depending on qps). Attaching quick notes and CPU sample.
maria: Hmm. Is this the adaptive-batching change too or just kernel selector? any recent config flips?
devin: We rolled kernel-score caching on by default, but also enabled mini-burst coalesce heuristic. Could be interaction.
alex: Copying the flame excerpt from 30s CPU sample (hot functions):\n\n```
pprof: top 10 flat
20.1%  runtime.tokenize_host
15.7%  runtime.grpc_writev_helper
12.3%  runtime.kernel_score_eval
9.4%   runtime.parse_proto_unmarshal
6.2%   runtime.kv_cache_miss_handler
5.0%   runtime.batch_coalesce_timer
...\n```

alex: KV cache hit-rate on the affected hosts dropped from ~97% -> ~82% during the spike window. Tail correlates with repeated kernel_score_eval + writev backpressure.
maria: That tokenization % is suspicious — we usually see tokenize_host under ~6%.
sara: Could be double-work: tokenization happening in both ingress unpack and again before kernel dispatch. Any traces of duplicate calls? alex: grep in logs showed `preparse:tokenize` then later `dispatch:tokenize` for same request id ~15% of samples.
devin: Kernel selection code does a safety re-score if batch size changes; if coalesce keeps changing batch_size we might re-run expensive scoring repeatedly. That plus a writev stall could cascade.
luis: Quick mitigation options: 1) cache kernel_score per (model, seq_len_bucket) for N seconds, 2) short-circuit tokenization if preparse flag present, 3) reduce mini-burst coalesce aggressiveness.
alex: I'm leaning to (2) + (1) as fast canary. Implement a `pretokenized` header and `kernel_score_cache_ttl=5s` default.
maria: We should also confirm RPC layer cost — grpc_writev_helper is a hot path. Any http2 hpack churn? alex: Yes, smallwrites pattern increased during bursts, HPACK table thrash increased compression misses.
sara: For canary, try `host.parse_pre_tokenize: true` and `ingress.min_coalesce_ms: 8` on a single vcluster, plus kernel_score_cache_ttl=5s.
devin: Agreed. I'll add a guard that skips kernel re-eval if batch_size delta < 2 tokens. cheap win.
infra-bot: canary-deployer: started canary rollout of config host.parse_pre_tokenize=true to vcluster-14 (20% traffic)
alex: Running a 30m smoke now, will post updated flame and kv hit-rate. If p95 drops back under baseline, we promote.
luis: Also open an issue to add telemetry counters: kernel_score_eval_count, tokenize_dedup_hits, writev_block_ms per host.
maria: FYI I'm going to instrument a short pcap on vcluster-14 to check http2 framing pattern.
alex: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: devin (kernel cache guard + TTL), sara (config + pcap), luis (telemetry counters). I'll monitor.
infra-bot: perf-alert: p95 on vcluster-14 decreased 9% after 12m into canary — monitoring continues :eyes:
alex: Nice. If improvement holds, we'll roll to 50% and then 100% with a release note describing kernel-selector caching and pretokenize opt-in.
